signals.signal: Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (period ended 30/06/2026, filed 29/07/2026): total Banking net sales fell 6.1% YoY to USD 638.1m and Banking PRODUCT net sales fell 13.0% YoY to USD 236.6m, the filing stating the decline was 'primarily due lower volume in Middle East, Africa and Europe, partially offset by a net favorable currency impact of 2.3% and higher pricing'. Six-month Banking products -9.5% to USD 469.6m, attributed to lower volume in North America and Europe. Banking fell from 74.2% to 68.6% of total net sales as Retail grew 24%. Tag: global OEM.
signals.source_name: US SEC EDGAR - Diebold Nixdorf Form 10-Q (CIK 28823), dbd-20260630.htm
signals.implies: Diebold Nixdorf is shipping materially fewer ATMs into Europe this year while its service base holds flat, which is the clearest evidence in the public record that its European hardware refresh cycle has softened. That is the moment to push Printec's NCR dispense, intelligent-deposit and recycling range plus x-core multivendor ATM software (software that lets one application drive ATMs from several manufacturers, so a bank is not locked to one OEM) at DN-installed accounts across SEE/CEE - Piraeus in Greece, Banca Intesa Serbia, Raiffeisenbank Croatia and PrivatBank Ukraine all run DN or Wincor fleets. Pair the hardware pitch with device telemetry/monitoring and managed field services, because DN's own margin note shows it is spending more on technician coverage.
signals.likelihood: High - the decline is already reported; the sales window is the 2026-27 refresh planning round
signals.followup: Map every known DN/Wincor ATM account in the 17-country footprint and time an NCR + x-core displacement pitch to their 2027 budget cycle; ask NCR Atleos for competitive-swap commercial support.

signals.signal: Q2 2026 earnings release (8-K exhibit 99.1, 29/07/2026): revenue USD 930.8m GAAP, adjusted EBITDA USD 120.6m, net income USD 16.2m, free cash flow NEGATIVE USD 11.0m excluding discrete tax payments 'driven by inventory to support increased demand'; USD 60m of shares repurchased in the quarter with ~USD 57m left on the USD 200m buyback. Named business highlights: 'Shipped a record number of teller cash recyclers in the quarter, won major Branch Automation Solutions, cash management and service contracts'; 'In Banking, backlog grew sequentially in the quarter'; retail point-of-sale unit sales up nearly 170% YoY IN EUROPE; Vynamic Smart Vision AI signed for 1,400 lanes across two large European grocers. FY2026 guidance reaffirmed at revenue USD 3.86-3.94bn, adjusted EBITDA USD 510-535m, FCF USD 255-270m, adjusted EPS USD 5.25-5.75. No acquisition or divestiture announced; capital is going to buybacks, not M&A. Tag: global OEM.
signals.source_name: US SEC EDGAR - Diebold Nixdorf 8-K Exhibit 99.1, Q2 2026 earnings release
signals.implies: Two direct threats to Printec lines. First, 'record teller cash recycler shipments' puts DN head-to-head with Printec's Glory/Sesami TCR business (a teller cash recycler is the branch-counter machine that accepts and re-dispenses the same notes, cutting cash handling) - Bank of Cyprus and any Greek/Croatian branch-automation prospect should be defended now. Second, DN is monetising ATM outsourcing through 'Branch Automation Solutions and cash management' contracts, which is exactly Printec's managed/field-services plus APTRA OptiCash cash-optimisation proposition; expect DN to bid managed-service scope, not just boxes, in footprint RFPs. The absence of any M&A and the buyback tell you DN will compete on price and service, not on buying a local integrator.
signals.likelihood: High - contracts are being signed now; DN reaffirmed guidance and has backlog cover for H2
signals.followup: Build a TCR defence pack (Glory/Sesami vs DN teller recycler) for Bank of Cyprus and Greek/Croatian branch-automation accounts, and an OptiCash + managed-services counter to DN Branch Automation Solutions.

signals.signal: Q2 2026 earnings call, 29/07/2026: CEO Octavio Marquez said total product backlog stands at USD 814m, grown sequentially, and first-half order entry was the highest in four years. On Europe he said it is 'a more mature market, very modest growth, but we're really winning in that market', citing a competitive win of approximately 1,100 DN Series units at a new UK customer, a Lloyds branch-automation pilot in two high-traffic branches, and separately 600 DN Series recyclers on a Mexican fleet refresh. CFO commentary put Banking revenue down ~6% YoY with Banking margin up 100bps to 28.5%. Tag: global OEM.
signals.source_name: The Motley Fool - Diebold Nixdorf (DBD) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
signals.implies: DN is explicitly running a competitive-displacement play in Europe - an 1,100-unit win at a NEW UK customer is a whole-fleet swap away from an incumbent, and that is the same motion it will run against NCR-installed banks in Printec's footprint. Printec should assume DN will lead with a total-cost-of-ownership and managed-service bundle rather than hardware price, and should pre-empt it at NCR reference accounts (Raiffeisen Serbia x-core, BCR APTRA, Erste Croatia OptiCash, PrivatBank and AikBank recyclers) with a renewal/expansion conversation before DN gets an RFP written around DN Series. The USD 814m backlog also means DN has delivery capacity committed into H2 2026 and will be aggressive on new logos.
signals.likelihood: Medium-High over the next 6-12 months in at least one footprint tender
signals.followup: Get the Q2 slide deck and Q3 call (late Oct 2026) for any named CEE/SEE win; brief account teams at the five NCR reference banks on DN's displacement playbook.

signals.entity: Diebold Nixdorf GmbH Banking Division (Austria) vs Geldservice Austria
signals.signal: Geldservice Austria (GSA, the Austrian banks' cash-logistics utility) directly awarded (Direktvergabe) 'Applikationssoftware und Gutscheinverarbeitung, keine Wartung' - application software and voucher processing, no maintenance - to DIEBOLD NIXDORF GmbH Banking Division (Stammzahl 9110015980561) for EUR 89,373.00, contract concluded 11/12/2025, 2 offers, CPV 48100000, published on the Austrian USP eProcurement portal 16/02/2026. GSA separately commissioned an explicitly MULTI-VENDOR cash-and-voucher software platform from Data Engineering GmbH (EUR 109,200, 10/12/2025). This matters because GSA's EUR 9,100,000 recycler framework (TED 305531-2026, published 05/05/2026, 'Kombinierte Ein- und Auszahlungsgeraete fuer effiziente und nachhaltige Bargeld- und GUTSCHEINlogistik', participation deadline 08/06/2026) is STILL UNAWARDED as of 27/08/2026 with contract start recorded 02/11/2026 and places of performance including Austria AND SLOVENIA. Tag: global OEM with local incumbency.
signals.source_name: USP eProcurement (Austria) award notice, via Agent 2 tender sweep 27/08/2026; TED notice 305531-2026
signals.implies: Diebold Nixdorf already sits inside Geldservice Austria on the voucher-processing software that the EUR 9.1m recycler framework names in its own title, which is a real incumbency advantage on the largest single cash-automation contest in Printec's footprint. The counter is that GSA deliberately bought a multi-vendor cash/voucher platform from a third party, so the award is not pre-decided on lock-in grounds - Printec should position NCR/Glory recyclers as the anti-lock-in choice and prove compatibility with the Data Engineering platform. Slovenia is a named place of performance, so a GSA win also reaches Printec S.I. d.o.o.'s home market.
signals.likelihood: Award decision due imminently - contract start is recorded as 02/11/2026
signals.followup: Confirm with GSA (Alexander Riedmueller, Print and Mint Services GmbH) whether the recycler framework is still in negotiation and whether DN is a shortlisted participant; get an x-core/recycler compatibility statement against the Data Engineering multi-vendor platform before the award lands.

signals.entity: Servus Systems Integration LLC (EDRPOU 31089403), Ukraine - supplying Diebold Nixdorf/Wincor spares to PrivatBank
signals.signal: PrivatBank (EDRPOU 14360570) awarded 'Krupnovuzlovi moduli ATM (Cash-kaseta, klampy, limbovyi zamok)' - 1,500 cash-dispense cassettes for Diebold Nixdorf (Wincor Nixdorf) ATMs, CPV 30123200-9 (ATMs), delivery to 13/06/2027 - to TOV Servus Systems Integration for UAH 7,211,025 incl. VAT (~EUR 139k), award 15/06/2026, reporting method, 0% saving. Prozorro ref UA-2026-06-15-012172-a, bank-portal id PB-2026-01-29-3067524; verified live on the Prozorro search API 31/08/2026 (status 'complete'). Tag: Servus = local-peer competitor; Diebold Nixdorf = global OEM whose installed base is being consumed.
signals.implies: This confirms, from a primary procurement record rather than inference, that Printec's flagship Ukrainian account PrivatBank still runs a substantial Diebold/Wincor ATM fleet alongside the 1,140 NCR recyclers Printec supplied - a genuinely mixed estate. That is the strongest possible argument for Printec's x-core multivendor ATM software and for a single consolidated spares-plus-field-service contract covering both fleets. It is also a small competitive loss: the cassette lot went to Servus Systems Integration, a Ukrainian full-stack rival that also represents Verifone and Nautilus Hyosung, so Printec is not currently capturing PrivatBank's DN-fleet consumables.
signals.likelihood: Recurring annual consumables/spares cycle; next round ~mid-2027
signals.followup: Bid PrivatBank's next DN/Wincor spares and cassette lots, and pitch x-core plus one unified field-service SLA across the NCR and Diebold fleets; profile Servus Systems Integration as the incumbent to beat.

VAT. It ran TWICE and FAILED both times: UA-2026-05-26-000817-a (offers closed 05/06/2026) and the re-run UA-2026-06-12-010225-a (offers closed 23/06/2026), both recorded 'unsuccessful' on Prozorro, and no third attempt is on the portal as of 31/08/2026. Tag: unmet requirement on Diebold-branded physical security.
signals.source_name: Prozorro (Ukraine public procurement) tenders UA-2026-05-26-000817-a and UA-2026-06-12-010225-a
signals.implies: An unfilled, twice-failed maintenance requirement at a Ukrainian bank that explicitly covers Diebold-lock safe-deposit boxes and vault doors maps straight onto Printec's physical ATM/bank-security and managed field-services lines. Because the market did not respond twice, Sens Bank will most likely negotiate directly or re-scope, which is the easiest possible entry point - a small contract but a door into a bank where Printec has no recorded incumbency, and one that positions Printec for the larger self-service work Sens Bank also tenders.
signals.likelihood: High that Sens Bank re-approaches the market or negotiates directly within 3-6 months
signals.followup: Contact Sens Bank procurement (Olena Klymenko, klimenkoe@sensebank.com.ua) about the failed CPV 50610000-4 lot and offer a direct-negotiation quote covering Diebold and Rosengrens lock servicing.

signals.entity: Diebold Nixdorf, Incorporated (global OEM) - Android device strategy
signals.signal: Diebold Nixdorf announced on 03/08/2026 that it has been validated as an Android Enterprise Gold Partner, the programme's highest tier for delivering and supporting enterprise-scale Android solutions - covering its DN Series self-service and retail point-of-sale device estate and their remote management. Separately DN's Q2 release reported retail point-of-sale UNIT sales up nearly 170% YoY in Europe. Tag: global OEM.
signals.source_name: PR Newswire - 'Diebold Nixdorf Recognized as an Android Enterprise Gold Partner'
signals.implies: DN is building formal credentials in Android fleet management, which is the same ground as Printec's terminal-management (TMS) offer around Verifone and Castles Android POS - the software layer that pushes configuration, keys and updates to a terminal estate remotely. This is directly live right now because PrivatBank CANCELLED its Android POS remote-management (TMS) tender pending an RFI decision after buying 20,000 Newland N950 Android terminals, so a large unresolved TMS requirement is open in Printec's flagship Ukrainian account and DN now has a credential to bid it. Printec should get its TMS proposition in front of PrivatBank before the RFI closes.
signals.likelihood: Medium in the next 6-12 months; the PrivatBank TMS RFI is live now
signals.followup: Respond to PrivatBank's Android POS TMS RFI with the Verifone/Castles TMS stack; track whether DN pitches Android device management into footprint POS estates.

signals.entity: Diebold Nixdorf / Komercni banka (Societe Generale group), Czech Republic
signals.signal: [STANDING - dated 02/12/2025] Diebold Nixdorf launched the DN Series 300 and 350 on the new DM7V dispensing module - shared cassette infrastructure across dispensers and recyclers, up to 14,000 notes and eight denominations, dual-cassette modular design, claimed ~40% greater availability, with real-time fleet monitoring, predictive maintenance and cash forecasting. Komercni banka, one of the largest Czech banks, is named as an early adopter that piloted the platform and installed the first DN Series 300 at its Stodulky headquarters; KB COO Jitka Haubova is quoted in the release. Tag: global OEM, footprint country.
signals.source_name: PR Newswire - 'Diebold Nixdorf Unveils DN Series 300 and 350: Transforming Self-Service Banking'
signals.implies: DN has put its newest dispenser/recycler generation into a Printec footprint country as a launch reference, and a launch pilot at a top-three Czech bank normally precedes a fleet rollout within 12-24 months - so a Czech ATM refresh is the most likely near-term DN expansion inside the footprint. Printec should treat the Czech market as contested and counter with NCR recycling ATMs plus x-core and telemetry, noting that DN's pitch here is explicitly the monitoring/predictive-maintenance layer rather than the box, which is where Printec's device telemetry and managed field services must be positioned. Note also KAL Kalignite already runs on NCR machines at Ceska sporitelna, so multivendor software is an accepted concept in this market.
signals.likelihood: KB fleet rollout plausible within 12-24 months of the Dec-2025 pilot
signals.followup: Watch Komercni banka and other Czech banks for a 2026-27 ATM refresh; check whether KB's rollout is procured publicly or bank-by-bank.

signals.signal: [STANDING - dated 21/10/2024] Diebold Nixdorf announced that Piraeus replaced its fleet of more than 1,200 in-branch self-service devices with DN Series cash recycling ATMs by end-2024, building on the 2021 deployment of more than 300 DN Series units that made Piraeus the first Greek bank to adopt cash recycling at scale. No newer Piraeus/DN trigger was found in Greek press (capital.gr, protothema.gr, iefimerida.gr, energia.gr) or on DN's investor newsroom in the delta window 24/07/2026-31/08/2026. Tag: global OEM.
signals.source_name: Diebold Nixdorf investor newsroom - 'Piraeus Migrates Majority of its ATM Network to Diebold Nixdorf's DN Series Cash Recyclers'
signals.implies: Piraeus is a closed DN estate for hardware for the medium term, so Printec's realistic Greek plays at that account are the layers DN does not own outright - cash optimisation (NCR APTRA OptiCash), independent transaction monitoring (INETCO), AML/KYC (Siron, FICO), HSMs (Thales) and physical security - rather than ATM replacement. Elsewhere in Greece the fresher contest is Mellon/NBG's Hyosung recycler programme and Euronet's CrediaBank ATM outsourcing, not DN.
signals.likelihood: No near-term change expected at Piraeus
signals.followup: Reconfirm at the next Greek banking-technology event whether Piraeus has a 2027 service/software re-tender; do not re-file this as news.

coverage_notes: Fresh run - no checkpoint existed for 2026-08-31, so full research was done. Primary-source first: SEC EDGAR 10-Q (dbd-20260630.htm) and 8-K exhibit 99.1 for the Q2 2026 numbers and the EMEA/Europe Banking-volume commentary (this is the JUDGMENT layer, not a re-key of the scripted competitor_series.json figures, which were read and used only as context: DN FY2025 revenue USD 3,805.7m, Banking USD 2,797.0m, Retail USD 1,008.7m). Q2 call detail (backlog USD 814m, UK ~1,100 DN Series competitive win, Mexico 600 recyclers, Europe commentary) is press-tier and marked Medium. Both hand-off items from Agent 2 were chased and verified: (a) Diebold Nixdorf GmbH Banking Division IS inside Geldservice Austria on voucher-processing software (EUR 89,373, 11/12/2025, USP-published 16/02/2026) which is a material incumbency risk on the still-unawarded EUR 9.1m GSA recycler framework whose contract start is 02/11/2026; (b) the Servus Systems Integration 1,500-cassette PrivatBank award was re-verified independently on the Prozorro search API on 31/08/2026 (UA-2026-06-15-012172-a, UAH 7,211,025, status complete) and confirms a mixed DN/Wincor + NCR estate at PrivatBank. NEW find not in the baseline or in Agent 2's list: Sens Bank Ukraine's twice-failed physical-security maintenance lot covering Diebold-lock deposit boxes (UA-2026-05-26-000817-a and UA-2026-06-12-010225-a, both 'unsuccessful', UAH 722,530, no third attempt on the portal) - an unfilled requirement Printec can approach directly. DN newsroom sweep May-Aug 2026 found only six releases (VyStar 05/05, Raj Singh CIO 18/05, D.A. Davidson 28/05, Q2 call notice 08/07, Q2 results 29/07, Android Enterprise Gold 03/08, Thomaston Savings Bank 11/08) - NO M&A, no divestiture, no strategic review; capital allocation is the USD 200m buyback with ~USD 57m left. DN AllConnect was researched: it remains the AI/analytics data engine underpinning DN Maintenance Services and appears in the Thomaston (US, 11/08/2026) deployment, but I found NO footprint-country DN AllConnect commercial win in the window, so it is reported as capability context inside the Q2 signal rather than as a separate unsourced win. Local-language sweeps run in Greek (capital.gr, protothema.gr, iefimerida.gr, energia.gr, ictplus.gr), Czech, Croatian (ictbusiness.info), Serbian, Romanian (zf.ro, futurebanking.ro, piatafinanciara.ro), Bulgarian and Ukrainian (Prozorro, systemgroup.com.ua, bankomservice.com.ua) - these surfaced only pre-2025 material, all of which is baseline. GENUINE GAPS: (1) Raiffeisenbank Croatia and Payten delivered Diebold Nixdorf CINEO deposit/withdrawal and recycler ATMs, described by Asseco SEE as 'one of the biggest cash recycling ATM deliveries on the Croatian market' - a real footprint competitive fact I could NOT date because the ASEE and Payten pages carry no publication date and the redirected asee.io URL 404s, so I have deliberately NOT filed it as a dated signal; it needs an operator to date it. (2) Da Fratello d.o.o. (Belgrade, +381 11 308 60 24) presents itself as a Diebold Nixdorf Partner in Serbia and is NOT in the 164-name roster - a candidate local-peer competitor, but its page carries no dates, customers or scope, so I did not file it as a signal. (3) VTE Group (Bulgaria) and bankomservice.com.ua (Ukraine) both advertise multi-OEM Diebold/Wincor/NCR ATM sales and servicing and are also absent from the roster - same problem, no dated trigger. (4) DAAC Digital (roster) and I.B.S. (Ukraine) remain DN service channels in Moldova/Romania/Ukraine with no fresh 2026 trigger found. The unsourced 'PrivatBank could not source DN recycler maintenance / DN service churn' hypothesis carried in the roster remains UNCONFIRMED - nothing in Prozorro this run supports it, and the Servus cassette award actually points the other way (the DN fleet is being maintained, just not by Printec).
